text:
{
  "found": true,
  "rule": {
    "trigger_kind": "incident",
    "event": "sfp_replaced",
    "symptoms": [
      "link_up",
      "counters_zero"
    ],
    "stated_condition": "older units",
    "condition_is_relative": true,
    "action": "interface.bounce",
    "action_text": "disable the interface, wait a little and enable it again",
    "avoid": [
      "node.reboot"
    ],
    "excerpt": "If the interface is UP but the counters stay at zero on the older units,\n> disable the interface, wait a little and enable it again.\n> Don't reboot the unit.",
    "said_by": "Erkki Expert",
    "said_by_role": "expert",
    "hedged": false,
    "first_hand": false,
    "outcome": "recovered",
    "outcome_excerpt": "Thanks Erkki, did exactly that on TRN-087, traffic is back.",
    "about_entity": "TRN-087",
    "retracts": false
  },
  "reason": "The quoted email from Erkki Expert provides a reusable rule for when an interface is up with zero counters on older units after an SFP swap, and Veikko confirms it resolved the issue."
}
